_comment: The pinned SOUP (software of unknown provenance) for the ESP32-C5 build:
ESP-IDF and the third-party code it bundles. This is the single source of
truth, maintained by hand like scripts/mksbom.py's COMPONENTS. From it,
scripts/ESP32C5/soup_sbom.py writes the SPDX SBOM (soup.spdx.json) and
scripts/ESP32C5/cvecheck.py matches the pinned versions against advisories.
'linked' is the attack surface that matters (plan section 4.2):
app       - linked into the application image
bootloader- linked into the 2nd-stage bootloader (secure-boot path)
unlinked  - present in ESP-IDF but garbage-collected out of the current
(milestone-1, no Wi-Fi/BLE) image; becomes linked when the
feature that needs it is turned on. cvecheck reports these as
'confirm' names where to read the true version in a local ESP-IDF install

framework.name: esp-idf
framework.git_commit: CONFIRM: git -C $IDF_PATH rev-parse HEAD (record the v5.5.6 tag commit)
framework.toolchain: CONFIRM: riscv32-esp-elf GCC from this IDF's tools (idf.py --version / toolchain --version)
framework.note: Pin one exact IDF version; capture dependencies.lock and the managed_components set for a reproducible image (plan section 4.1).

components.name: esp-idf
components.surface: The framework runtime (esp_system, esp_hal, heap, spi_flash, esp_rom, log, bootloader support). Espressif security advisories target this.

components.name: freertos-kernel
components.surface: The RTOS kernel the application task runs on. Always linked.

components.name: newlib
components.surface: C library (printf/scanf, string, malloc wrappers). Linked into the image.
components.confirm: the esp toolchain's newlib; _NEWLIB_VERSION in $IDF_PATH/components/newlib or the toolchain sysroot

components.name: mbedtls
components.surface: Secure Boot v2 / app-signature verification in the bootloader; the TLS stack (unlinked) once networking lands. Confirmed v3.6.3 in the IDF v5.5 line.

components.name: lwip
components.surface: TCP/IP stack. Not linked in the no-networking image; becomes linked with Wi-Fi. Espressif fork of lwIP 2.2.0.

components.name: wpa_supplicant
components.surface: Wi-Fi supplicant / WPA. Not linked without Wi-Fi. Espressif fork.

components.name: zlib
components.surface: Compression. Not linked unless a component that uses it is pulled in.

components.name: tinyusb
components.surface: USB device stack. The C5 console is the CH340 UART, so TinyUSB is not linked; would be linked only for a USB-device build.
components.confirm: $IDF_PATH managed component espressif/tinyusb version, or components/tinyusb
